text:
marta: quick sync — we need to finalize reserved pool surge rules for Q3 roadmap.
sam: main asks: predictable burst, cost transparency, safety.
leila: customers want a soft burst budget not to blow committed spend. default idea: 10% per 24h sliding window.
chen: engineering: prefer burst as consumable "surge_ru" with admission control and a concurrent slot cap.
deepa: ops: require circuit-breaker and clear fallback (model_variant or regional_spill). also runbook for immediate traffic shaping.
jordan_sales: ACME wants written SLAs for latency during burst or they go private. sales will offer paid higher burst tiers.
marta: suggestion — three tiers: default 10%, premium 30%, enterprise up to 60% with price uplift. configurable per contract.
chen: implementation sketch: continuous batching + KV pinning during surge, tokenized surge slots, backpressure on admission.
leila: add quality gate — no more than 2% regression on eval prompts during surge for pilot tenants.
deepa: ops metrics before GA: per-tenant 50/90/99 latency, surge_ru consumed, eviction_count, prewarm_gpu_hours. alert if queue_time >200ms for 1m.
sam: rollout plan: alpha (internal + 1 pilot) 2w, beta 4w with 6 customers, GA staged enable + UI toggles. abort if >5% SLA miss or >20% cost overrun.
marta: owners: leila = telemetry UI, chen = infra sim, deepa = runbook, jordan_sales = pricing matrix. reconvene Thu 10am PT. ops-bot: canary scheduled for policy "reserve_surge_v2" on staging 2024-08-05T18:00Z.
